in_marathi.name: Brahmavarchas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Brahmavarchas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Brahmavarchas is a name derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a compound name where 'Brahma' refers to the creator god and 'Varchas' means blessings. Thus, Brahmavarchas signifies receiving the blessings of the creator god Brahma.
